question: Should existing Prometheus model-call metric families gain the mandatory observation_unit label, or should synthetic agent-turn telemetry use separate metric families to preserve current series identities?
rationale: Both designs can represent the new turn boundary, but choosing whether existing dashboards and recording rules absorb a label-set change is a release and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness judgment.

options.title: Add the documented label
options.body: Keep shared model-call families, default legacy emitters to request, and explicitly document the observation_unit query migration before release.

options.title: Split turn metric families
options.body: Preserve existing request-series identities and publish synthetic agent-turn duration and outcome under separate bounded metric names.

recommendation.title: Add the documented label
recommendation.body: Keep shared model-call families, default legacy emitters to request, and explicitly document the observation_unit query migration before release.
